# runr_secret_store_trust (Data Source)

What a secret store has to trust so a region reads from it without a credential: the region cluster's service account issuer and its keys, the service account RunR names in the project namespace, the token subject and audience. Use it to configure the store's side — a Vault / OpenBao Kubernetes or JWT auth role, an AWS IAM OIDC provider and role trust policy, a GCP workload identity pool provider, an Azure federated credential. Needs `secret_stores.view`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "runr_region" "eu" {
  name = "eu-1"
}

# What the Vault store has to trust for region eu-1.
data "runr_secret_store_trust" "vault_eu" {
  store_id  = runr_secret_store.vault.id
  region_id = data.runr_region.eu.id
}

# Vault's JWT auth for the region (hashicorp/vault provider).
resource "vault_jwt_auth_backend" "runr_eu" {
  path                   = "runr-eu"
  jwt_validation_pubkeys = data.runr_secret_store_trust.vault_eu.pem_keys
}

resource "vault_jwt_auth_backend_role" "runr" {
  backend         = vault_jwt_auth_backend.runr_eu.path
  role_name       = "runr"
  role_type       = "jwt"
  bound_audiences = [data.runr_secret_store_trust.vault_eu.audience]
  bound_subject   = data.runr_secret_store_trust.vault_eu.subject
  user_claim      = "sub"
  token_policies  = ["runr-read"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `region_id` (String) Region id (`data.runr_region`).
- `store_id` (String) Store id (`runr_secret_store.<name>.id`) or name.

### Read-Only

- `audience` (String) Audience of its tokens (null for Vault's Kubernetes auth).
- `eso_status` (String) External Secrets Operator in the region: `ready`, `not_installed`, `installing`, `uninstalling` or `error`.
- `issuer` (String) The cluster's service account issuer URL.
- `jwks` (String) The issuer's keys as a JWKS document (JSON).
- `jwks_uri` (String) URL of the issuer's keys (JWKS).
- `namespace` (String) The region's project namespace.
- `pem_keys` (List of String) The issuer's public keys as PEM (Vault's `jwt_validation_pubkeys`).
- `publicly_reachable` (Boolean) Whether a cloud provider could fetch the issuer's discovery document (a hint; the provider decides). When false, give the keys to the store instead of the issuer URL.
- `region_name` (String) Region name.
- `service_account` (String) The service account the store logs in with (the store's `kubernetes_name`).
- `subject` (String) Subject of its tokens: `system:serviceaccount:<namespace>:<service account>`.
